thread.title: Apple Planning to Release New Low-Cost Laptop -Bloomberg

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple Planning to Release New Low-Cost Laptop -Bloomberg
text:
--Apple Inc. (AAPL) is planning to release a low-cost laptop later this year, with a display featuring a higher-resolution version of the "Retina" technology that Apple uses on other products, Bloomberg reported Monday, citing people familiar with the plans.
--Apple is also planning to introduce three new iPhones, Apple Watches that have larger screens and new iPad Pros, the report said, citing other people familiar with the plans.
--Apple is also planning an upgrade to the Mac mini, the report said.
--A company spokesman declined to comment, Bloomberg reported.
Full story: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-20/apple-is-said-to-plan-revamped-low-cost-macs-to-reignite-sales
